source_caption_text:
Lil Durk, Born Durk Derrick Banks, Is One Of Chicago’s Most Influential Rappers And The Founder Of OTF (Only The Family). He Rose From Chicago’s Drill Scene To Become A Global Hip-Hop Star, Known For His Emotional Storytelling, Melodic Style, And Raw Lyrics About His Life And Experiences. 🐐🔥

Over The Years, Durk Has Released Major Projects Like The Voice, 7220, Almost Healed, And Deep Thoughts, While Collaborating With Artists Like Lil Baby, J. Cole, Drake, Future, And Kanye West. His Joint Album With Lil Baby, The Voice Of The Heroes, Debuted At No. 1 On The Billboard 200. 📈

Durk Also Took Home His First Grammy For “All My Life” With J. Cole, Marking Another Major Milestone In His Career. 🏆

From Chicago Drill To The Global Rap Scene, Lil Durk Has Built A Legacy That Goes Far Beyond Music. 🏙️🔥
